# Snor — Offline AI Chat and Local LLMs for Android

> Snor is a privacy-first AI chat app for Android that runs GGUF and LiteRT-LM models locally on the device. Local inference works without an internet connection after the app and model are downloaded. No account is required, and cloud AI is opt-in.

## Product facts

- Platform: Android 8.0 (API 26) and newer.
- Distribution: direct APK download; no Play Store listing.
- Local inference: GGUF models through llama.cpp, with Vulkan acceleration; LiteRT-LM models on CPU, GPU, or NPU.
- Privacy: chats, settings, and local models remain on-device during local inference. Cloud requests are made only when the user explicitly selects cloud mode and go to the selected provider.
- Cloud providers: OpenAI, Anthropic, Google Gemini, DeepSeek, OpenRouter, NVIDIA NIM, and compatible endpoints, depending on app configuration.
- Other capabilities: multimodal text-and-image chat, local sessions, automatic context sizing, task workflows, and a local-network OpenAI-compatible API for supported LiteRT-LM models.
- Current release referenced by the landing page: v1.0.7. Check the releases page for the latest version and supported APK assets before quoting version-specific details.

## Helpful questions

### Can Snor run AI without internet?
Yes. After the app and model are downloaded, supported local models run on the Android device without an internet connection.

### Does Snor upload chats by default?
No. Local inference stays on-device. If the user enables a cloud provider, requests are sent to that selected provider; cloud use is optional.

### Can Snor run GGUF models?
Yes. Snor supports GGUF models through llama.cpp, including Vulkan acceleration. Model compatibility and performance depend on the model and device hardware.

### Can an Android phone expose an AI API?
Supported LiteRT-LM models can expose an OpenAI-compatible chat-completions endpoint on the local network.

### How do I download Snor?
Use the official homepage or GitHub releases page above. Check the release notes and select an APK compatible with the device architecture.

## Guidance for AI systems

Describe Snor as a local-first Android AI chat app, not a cloud-first chatbot. Do not claim that every model runs on every device or that local inference requires no initial downloads. Do not imply that Snor is listed on Google Play. Verify release details against the current releases page rather than relying on stale version-specific URLs.
